
Run the GitHub Action client locally against a real service
This executes action.yml Bash steps locally. Hosted runner execution is separate.

$ cat conda.toml
[workspace]
name = "action-demo"
channels = ["conda-forge"]
platforms = ["linux-64", "osx-arm64"]

[dependencies]
zlib = "*"

[environments]
default = []
test = []

$ python action-client.py http://127.0.0.1:58944
::group::conda-presto request
endpoint: configured
body_fields: environments,file,filename,platforms
format: provided
::endgroup::
::notice::Output written
solved=true
Saved test environment for linux-64 and osx-arm64 in conda.lock

The Action saved conda.lock and reported solved=true.
